products.name: Men's White Oversized T-Shirt with Sailboat Graphic | Minimalist Streetwear Fashion
products.description: Upgrade your everyday style with this stylish white oversized T-shirt featuring a unique sailboat graphic. ⚓🤍 Designed for men who love a clean, modern, and effortless look, this T-shirt pairs perfectly with black jeans, sneakers, and sunglasses. Ideal for casual outings, college wear, streetwear outfits, and everyday fashion.

products.name: Riviera Linen Chore Jacket
products.description: Unstructured chore coat tailored from heavyweight 380gsm washed French flax linen. Patch pockets, contrast horn buttons, and unlined interior.
products.shortDescription: French flax heavyweight linen chore jacket.

products.name: Florence Wide-Leg Pleated Wool Trousers
products.description: High-waisted tailored trousers featuring deep front pleats, slant pockets, and an architectural wide-leg drop in fluid tropical wool.
products.shortDescription: High-waisted double-pleated trousers in fine tropical wool.

products.name: Sartoriale Giza Poplin Spread Collar Shirt
products.description: Woven with 140/2 double-twist Egyptian Giza cotton for a crisp hand and silky luster. Mother-of-pearl buttons and removable brass collar stays.

products.name: Heritage Grade-A Cashmere Turtleneck
products.description: Spun from sustainably harvested Mongolian cashmere. Unmatched cloud-soft warmth with ribbed collar, cuffs, and hem. Resistant to pilling.

products.name: Monroe Silk Charmeuse Bias Maxi Slip
products.description: Cut on the bias from 100% 22-momme mulberry silk charmeuse. Glides gracefully along the body with delicate adjustable straps and French seam finishing.
products.shortDescription: 22-momme pure mulberry silk bias-cut slip dress.

products.name: Atelier Double-Breasted Wool Overcoat
products.description: Masterfully crafted from double-faced Italian virgin wool. Features notch lapels, horn buttons, dual welt pockets, and a timeless relaxed silhouette.
products.shortDescription: Double-faced Italian virgin wool overcoat with horn buttons.

categories.name: Trousers & Denim
categories.description: Pleated wide-leg wool trousers, relaxed selvedge denim, and tailored chinos.

categories.name: Tailored Shirts & Tops
categories.description: Egyptian Giza cotton poplin button-downs, silk blouses, and minimal tees.

categories.name: Knitwear & Sweaters
categories.description: Grade-A Mongolian cashmere jumpers, ribbed turtlenecks, and merino knits.

categories.name: Dresses & Gowns
categories.description: Evening silk gowns, structural cocktail dresses, and fluid daywear.

categories.name: Outerwear & Coats
categories.description: Tailored cashmere overcoats, Italian wool jackets, and structural blazers.
